question: What is zoneless Angular?
shortAnswer: Running Angular without Zone.js patching, relying on signals and explicit notifications for updates.
detailedAnswer: provideExperimentalZonelessChangeDetection (or current zoneless APIs) removes Zone overhead. Async work must update signals/mark views dirty.

question: Why move to zoneless?
shortAnswer: Less monkey-patching, clearer reactivity, better performance predictability, smaller bundle.
detailedAnswer: Requires discipline: third-party libs that expect Zone may break. Signals become the primary update path.

question: How do you trigger UI updates without Zone.js after setTimeout?
shortAnswer: Update a signal or call ChangeDetectorRef.markForCheck/detectChanges inside the callback.
detailedAnswer: Wrapping in NgZone.run is the Zone-era approach; zoneless prefers signals. Test carefully.

question: What library risks appear when going zoneless?
shortAnswer: Libs that rely on Zone to refresh UI after async work may not update until you bridge updates.
detailedAnswer: Prefer signal-friendly patterns. Audit charting/auth SDKs. Add thin adapters that set signals on callbacks.
